description: This Java source file defines the class 'FingerprintAuthenticationDialogFragment', which implements a UI dialog for fingerprint authentication with fallback to password authentication in an Android application. It manages UI components, authentication flow, backend enrollment, and communication with other components.

classes.name: FingerprintAuthenticationDialogFragment
classes.description: An Android DialogFragment that handles fingerprint authentication, password fallback, UI management, and backend enrollment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, maintains state across configuration changes, and performs enrollments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the dialog layout, initializes UI components, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts fingerprint listening when the dialog is in the foreground.

methods.name: setStage
methods.description: Sets the current authentication stage (FINGERPRINT, PASSWORD, etc.).

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stop listening for fingerprint authentication when the dialog is no longer active.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Obtains reference to the hosting activity.

methods.name: setCryptoObject
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic object used for fingerprint authentication.

methods.name: goToBackup
methods.description: Switches UI to password fallback mode.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls a user to a fake backend and provides the public key for verification.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies the entered password against the backend and updates preferences upon success.

methods.name: updateStage
methods.description: Updates UI components based on the current authentication stage.

methods.name: onEditorAction
methods.description: Handles IME action for the password input field.

methods.name: onAuthenticated
methods.description: Callback executed upon successful fingerprint authentication; signs data and verifies with backend.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles fingerprint authentication errors by switching to backup mode.
